verses.text: Ayik ix lajwi slolon winhaj David yet' winhaj Saúl chi', haxo winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Saúl chi', te wach' ix yil winhaj David chi' winh icha wal syutej syailan sb'a.
Hanheja' winhaj Saúl chi', ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix yak'kanoch yopisio winhaj David chi' winh, majxo yak'laj meltzaj winh winh t'a spat smam.
Ix yak' sti' winhaj Jonatán t'a winhaj David chi' to wach' ol yil-laj sb'a heb' winh t'a masanil tiempo, yujto te xajan winhaj David chi' yuj winh.
Ix yik'anpaxel masanil spichul winhaj Jonatán yik owal ayoch yuj, ix yak'an winh t'a winhaj David chi' yet' k'e'en yespada, jul-lab' yet' cincho ayoch t'a snanhal winh.

Masanil b'aj ix chekji winhaj David yuj winhaj Saúl chi' t'a owal, te wach'nhej ix elk'och winh, yuj chi' ix ak'jioch winh yajalil t'a jun makan heb' soldado. Yuj chi' ix te tzalaj heb' soldado yet' heb' ayoch yopisio yuj winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ayik ix jax heb' soldado smasanil t'a owal, ayik toxo ix chamkan winh filisteo yuj winhaj David chi', ix laj elta heb' ix ix t'a junjun chonhab' yik scha'an heb' ix sjawi winhaj rey Saúl chi'. Sk'e chennaj heb' ix tz'elta heb' ix, stzinhan k'e'en spandereta heb' ix yet' k'e'en splatillo.
Wan sb'itan heb' ix tz'elta heb' ix, syalan heb' ix icha tik: Smilal heb' ajk'o'ol ix smilcham winhaj Saúl. Lajlajunh miltak ix smilcham winhaj David, xchi heb' ix.

Ha jun chi', te ya ix och ix yab' winhaj Saúl chi', yuj chi' ix chichonk'e sk'o'ol winh, ix yalan winh: --Ste ik'jiwalcha'anh winhaj David t'a wichanh, yuj chi' syal heb' ix ix tik to lajlajunh miltak ix smilcham winh, a inxo tik jayenhej mil ix in milchamok. Jab'xonhej wal yoch winh tik reyal in k'exulok, xchi spensar winh chi'.
Atax ta' ix ochkan chi'an sk'ol winh t'a winhaj David chi'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix och jun espíritu chuk yuj Jehová t'a winhaj Saúl chi', ix och lokoax winh t'a sdespacho, ix och ijan winhaj David schalan te' arpa, ichataxon sk'ulej, yet'k'e jun k'e'en lanza winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ix kot wal numnaj t'a sjolom winh ix yila', ix sjulanoch k'e'en slanza winh chi' t'a winhaj David chi', yik tz'ochkan ch'apnaj winh yet' k'e'en t'a sat pat chi' sna'an winh, palta chael ix skol sb'a winhaj David chi'.
Ix xiwk'e winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj David chi', yujto a Jehová ayoch yet' winhaj David chi', haxo pax yet' winh jun, manhxo ayok ochlaj Jehová chi'.

Yuj chi', manhxo'ok t'a spat winh chi' ix munlaj winhaj David chi', palta to ix yik'el winh winh t'a stz'ey. Ix yak'anoch winh winh yajalil t'a jun mil heb' soldado, haton winh et'jinak heb' ayik ix xit'ek' heb' t'a owal.
Yalnhej b'aj ix ek' winhaj David chi', wach'nhej tz'aj yelk'ochi, yujto a Jehová ayoch yet' winh.
Yuj chi' ix te wach' xiw winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winh.
Masanil heb' israel yet' heb' aj Judá, te xajan winhaj David chi' yuj heb'. Ste tzalaj heb' yet' winh yujto a winh skuchb'an heb' t'a owal.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj David chi': --Swak' ix b'ab'el wisil skuchan Merab etb'eyumok, anhej to jelannhej tzutej a b'a t'a owal, tzak'an owal kuj a onh schonhab' onh Jehová tik, xchi winh. Ix sna winhaj Saúl icha chi' yujto malaj snib'ej winh yoch smul smilan winhaj David chi', wach' hama tato a heb' filisteo smilan winh sna'an winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi': --Mamin rey, malaj jab'ok welk'ochi, manh niwanoklaj yelk'och in mam yet' heb' in k'ab' wok t'a skal heb' ketisraelal yik tzin och a nhi'ok, xchi winh.
Haxo yik ix k'och stiempoal yak'an ix yisil winhaj Saúl chi' yetb'eyumok winh, haton ix Merab, haxo t'a winhaj Adriel aj Mehola ix yak' ix winh.
Haxo junxo ix yisil winh skuchan Mical, te ay snib'ej ix t'a winhaj David chi'. Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Saúl chi' icha chi', te wach' ix yab' winh.

Yuj chi' ix sna'an winh to ol yak' junxo ix yisil winh chi' yetb'eyumok winhaj David chi', yik wach' yuj ix ol miljokcham winhaj David chi' yuj heb' filisteo. Ix yalan winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj David t'a schaelal: --Ha tiknaik, wal yel ol ach och in nhi'ok, xchi winh.

Ix stz'akan yal winh t'a heb' winh ayoch t'a yopisio yuj: --Tzex lolon yet' winhaj David he ch'okoj, tzeyalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha winh rey, tzach ste xajanej winh, tzach ko xajanejpax a onh tik. Yuj chi' ach ochokab' snhi'ok winh rey chi', xe chi t'a winh, xchi winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ix b'at heb' winh ay yopisio chi' yal juntzanh chi' t'a winhaj David chi', ix tak'wi winh t'a heb' icha tik: --Am he na'ani to sekojtak woch snhi'ok winh rey chi', ina to meb'a' in, malaj jab'ok welk'ochi, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at heb' schekab' winhaj Saúl chi' yal t'ay, tas ix aj yalan winhaj David chi'.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Saúl chi' t'a heb' ay yopisio chi': --Alek t'a winh, max stuplaj ix wisil tik winh icha sb'eyb'al heb' anima, anhej syik'kot 100-ok sjolom swinakil heb' winh filisteo winh t'ayin. Icha chi' tz'aj in pakan in b'a t'a heb' wajk'ol chi', xe chi t'a winh, xchi winh rey chi'. Icha chi' ix yutej winh rey chi' yalani yik smiljicham winhaj David chi' yuj heb' filisteo chi'.
Ix b'atxi heb' ay yopisio chi' yal t'a winhaj David chi'. Ix scha'an sk'ol winh yoch snhi'ok winh rey chi'. Ayik manto k'ochlaj sk'ual,

ix b'at winhaj David chi' yet' heb' soldado, ix smilancham 200 heb' winh filisteo winh. Tz'akan ix yik'kot sjolom swinakil heb' winh winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi' yik tz'ochkan winh snhi'ok winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an ix Mical yisil winhaj Saúl chi' yetb'eyumok winh.
Ix nachajel yuj winhaj Saúl chi', ix yilan winh to a Jehová ayoch yet' winhaj David chi', ix yilanpax winh to te xajan winh yuj ix Mical chi',
yuj chi' ix te wach' xiwk'e winh t'a winh, ix te wach' och winh ajk'olal t'a winh.

Ha heb' filisteo ix te ochnhej heb' yak' owal yet' heb' israel, palta a winhaj David chi', te jelan winh t'a owal t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' yetyajalil soldado winhaj Saúl t'a juntak el, yuj chi' ix te b'inaj winh.
